page.overview:
What is Steel Wool Studios?

Steel Wool Studios, Inc., formally known as Steel Wool Games, Inc., is a video game development company that was founded on October 10, 2012, in Oakland, California, by Sequoia Blankenship, Andrew Dayton, Jonathan Hoffman, Joshua Qualtieri, and Jason Topolski.

In 2017, Scott Cawthon began working with the company to develop Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, and later its DLC Curse of Dreadbear, both of which would release in 2019. They would become the main developer for the core series Five Nights at Freddy's video games, developing Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach, its DLC RUIN, Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2, and Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic, with more video games planned to be developed by them in the future.

The company has held events at PAX West in 2023 and 2024. They're also the production company behind the promotional short series Freddy & Friends: On Tour! and MCM Archive.

Only those who have worked on the franchise are listed.
